fields.statement: No milestone is open (rhiza health: roadmap 0 milestones; milestone 29's change sets have all landed), so change set 01M6VY7H (Autonomy per workflow) has nothing to serve, and the plan workflow's milestone-check step fails a plan whose change set serves no milestone. Its three sibling requests from decision workflows-are-the-rules (workflow dispatch 01M6VY7G6H, scheduling as policy 01M6VY7GRV, request --ref 01M6VY7JMM) are in the same spot. What should it serve? / Which workflow's autonomy declaration governs which stage of a change set? Today one plan run (plan workflow) covers plan and accept, and a later ship-change run covers ship and signoff; workflow dispatch (01M6VY7G6H) will record on the change set the workflow its request chose, so the ship pick follows it. / How does milestone planning get its owner-only default? Today milestone requests run the built-in 'plan' workflow with --milestone, and daemonStartPlan (internal/api/request.go:366-371) hard-codes that such a run is never autonomous.
